name: Confirm window per private attempt
comparison: reconcileInclusion polls receipt and nonce while Date.now() < start + window; the deadline is checked only between awaited RPC calls
representation: integer via Number.parseInt, must be finite and > 0 (reconciliation.ts:679-683)
effective_non_numeric: 45000; a prefix like "45000ms" parses as 45000 and "1.5" as 1
overlap: held inside the wallet nonce lock once per not-natively-confirmed attempt (4 attempts on a snipe, AUD-TX-003); the exit guard reuses it outside the lock (TH-EXIT-22); must stay below WATCHDOG_BUDGET_MS (TH-BUY-14, TH-EXIT-21)
recommendation: Decide on card OD-17 how long a buy may hold the lock in total (not per attempt); make the window per chain (2 s blocks on Base vs 12 s on ETH) and check the deadline per call (TX-01).

name: Poll interval inside the confirm window
comparison: sleep between receipt/nonce probes
representation: integer via Number.parseInt, must be finite and > 0 (reconciliation.ts:679-683)
rationale: none in code beyond the default list
overlap: each poll is 2 RPC calls with no per-call timeout (AUD-TX-008)

name: Private priority-fee ceiling actually applied (buy AND sell legs)
comparison: submitted priority = min(max(step x (attempt+1), chain priority), ceiling, affordability bound); ceilingHit when the clamped fee >= ceiling ends the escalation
representation: float via Number.parseFloat, must be finite and > 0, then gweiToWei = parseUnits(n.toFixed(9), "gwei") (reconciliation.ts:685-689, :697-701)
effective_non_numeric: 25; 0 or negative -> 25; a value >= 1e21 prints in exponent form and parseUnits throws inside buildReconcileConfig, so every private submit throws
rationale: 21.3 D-PRIVATE-INCLUSION-HARDEN mech 3: buy headroom at calm gas (reconciliation.ts:63-68)
overlap: documented as the buy-only ceiling, but the strategies always build the buy config, so it is also the private SELL ceiling (AUD-TX-010); TH-EXIT-23 assumes MEV_SELL_MAX_PRIORITY_FEE_GWEI applies to sells instead
recommendation: Pass the leg to the strategies so this caps buys only, bound the accepted range at load, and parse gwei from the string rather than through a float (card TX-02).

name: Sell-leg priority-fee ceiling (registered, never applied to a submit)
comparison: read only when buildReconcileConfig gets leg "sell", which happens only for the exit guard (exitEngine.ts:940) whose ceiling value is unused
representation: float via Number.parseFloat, must be finite and > 0, then gweiToWei = parseUnits(n.toFixed(9), "gwei") (reconciliation.ts:685-689, :697-701)
effective_non_numeric: no effect (a value >= 1e21 would still throw in the guard's buildReconcileConfig, exitEngine.ts:940, aborting that exit attempt)
rationale: Finding A (config.ts:190): an independent sell ceiling
overlap: TH-EXIT-23 records the same key as capping private sells; at the base SHA it does not (AUD-TX-010); the public-fallback alert tells the operator to raise it (exitEngine.ts:536)
recommendation: Wire it to the private sell leg or delete it and fix the alert text (card TX-02).

name: Legacy "load-bearing" priority-fee cap
comparison: none: no code reads env.MEV_MAX_PRIORITY_FEE_GWEI; MEV_RECONCILE_DEFAULTS.maxPriorityFeeGwei (5) is also unused
rationale: .env.example:226 calls it "the load-bearing safety cap"; the ceiling-hit alert (reconciliation.ts:607) tells the operator to increase it
overlap: the enforced ceiling is TH-TX-03 (25 gwei), five times the documented cap
recommendation: Decide on card TX-02 whether it becomes the hard cap over both legs or is removed; fix .env.example and the alert text either way.

name: Priority-fee escalation step
comparison: escalated = step x (attempt + 1); desired = max(escalated, chain priority) (reconciliation.ts:502-514)
representation: float via Number.parseFloat, must be finite and > 0, then gweiToWei = parseUnits(n.toFixed(9), "gwei") (reconciliation.ts:685-689, :697-701)
overlap: the first attempt already bids at least one step, on every chain (AUD-TX-016)
recommendation: Make the step and first-attempt floor per chain or relative to the observed priority fee (card TX-02).

name: Reserve sell gas switch
comparison: when true the affordability bound subtracts sellGasLimit x (baseFee x 1.5)
representation: string; only "false" after trim + lower-case disables (parseBoolDefaultTrue)
effective_non_numeric: true for anything except "false" ("0", "no", "off" all keep it on)
overlap: also applied on the private SELL leg, where it reserves gas for a second sell that does not exist (AUD-TX-010)
recommendation: Apply the reserve to buys only once the strategies know the leg (card TX-02).

name: Runtime sell-reserve base-fee buffer
comparison: reserve = (sellGasLimit + approvalGasLimit) x baseFeeWei x 1.5
representation: constant; applied via applyGasMultiplier (round(m x 100) / 100, bigint)
rationale: pads a modest base-fee rise between buy and sell (reconciliation.ts:41-44)
overlap: baseFeeWei is already 2 x the latest base fee (TH-TX-09), so the effective buffer is 3x; the buy-time gate uses EXIT_GATE_SELL_GAS_BUFFER 2.0 (TH-EXIT-26), effectively 4x
recommendation: Re-derive the buffer once the real base fee is used (card TX-02).

name: Base-fee derivation for affordability and the sell reserve (RC-22)
current_value: maxFeePerGas - maxPriorityFeePerGas = 2 x latest block base fee
comparison: feeds headroom = balance - value - reserve - gasLimit x baseFee (reconciliation.ts:328) and the submitted maxFeePerGas = baseFee + priority (flashbots.ts:211, passthrough.ts:105)
effective_non_numeric: n/a; legacy chains (BSC) use gasPrice, not doubled (bloxroute.ts:92)
rationale: comments call it "EIP-1559 base" (flashbots.ts:167-168); ethers defines maxFee as 2 x base + tip
overlap: TH-TX-08 and TH-EXIT-26 multiply it again
recommendation: Use the latest block baseFeePerGas for affordability; keep 2 x base + tip only as the submitted cap (card TX-02, AUD-TX-007).

name: ethers priority-fee fallback relied on as the competitive floor
comparison: chainPriorityWei = feeData.maxPriorityFeePerGas (x anti-rug multiplier) is folded in as the desired-fee floor
overlap: on Base/Arbitrum a failed priority query silently becomes a 1 gwei floor (far above the market tip on those chains)
recommendation: Treat a failed priority query as unknown (log it) rather than as 1 gwei on L2s (card TX-02).

name: Flashbots target blocks per attempt
comparison: targetBlock = head + 1; the same signed bundle is sent for targetBlock .. targetBlock + N - 1 (one raw relay call each); bundle.wait() watches only targetBlock
overlap: at 8 blocks (~96 s) an attempt's bundle stays eligible after the next attempt is signed at the same nonce, so an earlier attempt can land while only the latest hash is reconciled (AUD-BUY-002 mechanism)
recommendation: Keep N x block time below the bundle wait + confirm window, or reconcile every attempt's hash (AUD-BUY-002 fix, card BUY-02).

name: Builder fanout list (count and names)
comparison: sent as the builders field of every raw eth_sendBundle
effective_non_numeric: any string is accepted; only all-commas falls back to the default
rationale: beaverbuild.org and Titan must always be present (.env.example:275)
overlap: none
recommendation: Warn at load when beaverbuild.org or Titan is missing from an override (the documented requirement is not enforced).

name: Default private attempts when the caller passes no budget (snipe buys, partial sells)
comparison: loop attempt = 0 .. maxRetries inclusive
representation: number; an explicit 0 or negative is honoured (?? 3)
rationale: WR-04 (txManager.ts:99-106): buy behaviour unchanged at 4 attempts
overlap: with TH-TX-01 this is the ~4 minute lock hold behind which an anti-rug exit waits (AUD-TX-003)
recommendation: Bound the total lock hold of one escalation (card OD-17).

name: Private attempt budget to maxRetries mapping
comparison: budget 0 -> -1 -> no private submission; 1 -> one; 2 -> two
effective_non_numeric: n/a (budgets parsed by the callers: TH-EXIT-12 MEV_SELL_FALLBACK_ATTEMPTS, TH-BUY-06 DELIBERATE_BUY_PRIVATE_ATTEMPTS)
overlap: TH-EXIT-12, TH-BUY-06

name: Fallback gas limits and the sell gas reserved per strategy
current_value: 300000 (Flashbots), 500000 (passthrough, bloXroute); sellGasLimit = the buy tx gasLimit
comparison: used only when the caller passes no gasLimit; callers pass ctx.chain.gas.maxGasLimit (chainRegistry.ts:204 ETH 300000, :273 BSC 500000, :330 Base 500000, :387 Arbitrum 1000000)
rationale: the sell leg reserves the same chain gas budget (flashbots.ts:158-160)
overlap: the reserve uses the gas LIMIT, not expected use, times 3x base (TH-TX-08/09)

name: Escalation and ceiling-hit rule
current_value: desired = max(step x (attempt+1), chain priority); stop when clamped fee >= ceiling or >= affordability bound
comparison: a not-landed attempt ends the escalation when the clamp binds or attempts run out
rationale: CR-01: the clamp is the final authority (reconciliation.ts:545-550)
overlap: TH-TX-03, TH-TX-06

name: bloXroute relay and health-check timeouts
comparison: axios timeout; a relay timeout defers to chain reconciliation (not a failure)
rationale: bloxroute.ts:146-154 (a timeout may fire after the relay accepted)
overlap: the only bounded network calls in the slice (AUD-TX-008)

name: Flashbots library bundle.wait() timeout
current_value: 300000 ms (5 min), rejects with the bare string "Timed out"
comparison: resolves on the first block event >= targetBlock; otherwise rejects after 5 minutes
overlap: held under the wallet nonce lock; the async block handler can crash the process (AUD-TX-009)
recommendation: Replace with the slice's own bounded reconcile (AUD-TX-009) and bound the hold (card OD-17).

name: HTTP request timeout of every provider and relay call (ethers FetchRequest default)
comparison: applies to every JsonRpcProvider call and every relay request; idle, not total
overlap: TH-TX-20 documents a 15 s timeout that does not exist
recommendation: Construct providers and relay requests with an explicit bounded timeout (card TX-01, AUD-TX-008).

name: Documented per-RPC-call timeout
comparison: none: no code reads RPC_TIMEOUT_MS
rationale: Finding B (config.ts:180): "Promise.race frees a hung call"
overlap: withTimeout exists (src/utils/withTimeout.ts) but is used only around the whole anti-rug exit (exitTrigger.ts:265)
recommendation: Wire it (TH-TX-19) or remove the registration (card TX-01).

name: Passthrough native-confirm depth and timeout (Base, Arbitrum)
comparison: tx.wait(3): resolves at 3 confirmations, throws on replacement or status 0, otherwise waits forever
representation: literal 3; timeout argument omitted (ethers default 0 = none)
rationale: passthrough.ts:133-137 assumes the wait "may TIME OUT"; it cannot
overlap: runs inside the wallet nonce lock (AUD-TX-002); the MEV confirm window never applies to a stuck tx
recommendation: Pass a bounded timeout and reconcile on timeout (card TX-01).

name: Provider block polling interval (drives every wait and bundle.wait)
comparison: JsonRpcProvider polls for new blocks; block events resolve wait() and the library bundle.wait()
overlap: Base/Arbitrum produce blocks faster than the poll

name: Generic retry helper attempts and backoff
current_value: retries 3, delay 1000 ms, factor 2 (waits 1 s, 2 s, 4 s)
comparison: attempt > retries rethrows
overlap: callers are the token-safety HTTP checks only (tokenSafety.ts:28, :65, safetyProviders/*), i.e. pre-buy screening time; no signing call is wrapped, so it cannot double-send

name: Receipt-decoder retry
current_value: one retry after 2000 ms, then nulls
comparison: a still-null receipt records amountOut, gasCost and blockNumber as null on the sell row
overlap: bookkeeping only (AUD-TX-015)

name: Gas multiplier arithmetic (anti-rug exits)
comparison: raises only the chain-priority floor; the result is still clamped by the ceiling and the affordability bound, and the base part of maxFeePerGas is not multiplied
representation: float multiplier rounded to 1/100, then bigint
effective_empty: n/a (parsed by the anti-rug config, TH-ANTIRUG-05)
effective_non_numeric: n/a; a multiplier below 0.005 rounds to 0 and zeroes the floor
overlap: TH-ANTIRUG-05 / TH-EXIT-20 own the value; at the 25 gwei ceiling or a binding affordability bound the "2x anti-rug gas" has no effect
recommendation: State in the anti-rug config docs that the multiplier is clamped; decide on card TX-02 whether anti-rug exits get their own ceiling.

name: Coinbase-bribe switches (buy and sell)
comparison: none (documented as RESERVED / NOT-YET-WIRED)
overlap: none
recommendation: Remove the registrations in Phase 29 hygiene unless a bribe bundle is planned; the no-effect status is already documented, so no behaviour decision.

name: Dead gasManager multipliers and gas limit
comparison: none: no production caller (AUD-TX-013)
overlap: the chain gas.multiplier is read only here among the slice files
